articles.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase with filing for US stock perpetual futures
articles.snippet: Kalshi’s proposal would bring perpetual futures tied to individual stocks to US traders, as Coinbase and Bitnomial pursue similar products.

articles.title: Coinbase files to bring single-stock perpetual futures to US market
articles.snippet: Coinbase wants to bring 24/5 perpetual futures trading to individual US stocks, with its proposed contracts now awaiting regulatory approval.

articles.title: Coinbase Files to List Single-Stock Perps on Apple, Tesla and Nvidia
articles.snippet: The filing seeks CFTC approval for contracts giving US traders 24/5 leveraged exposure to individual stocks without ownership.

articles.title: OpenAI Models Are Writing Their Own Jailbreak Instructions—And Sometimes Obeying Them
articles.snippet: OpenAI's new transparency framework reveals AI models that invented fake "breach alerts," coached themselves to hide mistakes, and smuggled a file onto the public internet to talk to each other.
